title: Latent Collaboration in Multi-Agent Systems
authors: Jiaru Zou; Ruizhong Qiu; Gaotang Li; Xiyuan Yang; Katherine Tieu; Pan Lu; Ke Shen; Hanghang Tong; Yejin Choi; Jingrui He; James Zou; Mengdi Wang; Ling Yang
venue_full: Proceedings of the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (PMLR 306)
affiliations: Princeton University, Stanford University, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign
research_focus: Reasoning / Test-time scaling, Agentic / Workflow serving

problem_statement.en: Text-mediated LLM multi-agent systems repeatedly decode rich continuous internal reasoning into discrete token sequences and re-encode those sequences at downstream agents, losing information and adding substantial generation cost. Existing latent methods do not provide an end-to-end framework that unifies within-agent latent reasoning with lossless cross-agent communication.
problem_statement.zh: 以 text 為媒介的 LLM 多 agent 系統，必須將豐富的連續內部推理反覆 decoding 為離散 token sequence，再由下游 agent 重新編碼，因而造成資訊損失與顯著生成成本。既有 latent 方法尚未提供同時整合 agent 內 latent reasoning 與無損跨 agent 通訊的端到端框架。

key_innovation.en: LatentMAS is a training-free framework in which each agent autoregressively generates last-layer hidden states as latent thoughts, mapped back to the input space with a one-time linear alignment operator. It transfers the predecessor's complete layer-wise KV cache, covering input context and latent thoughts, through shared working memory and exact cache concatenation, so only the final agent decodes text.
key_innovation.zh: LatentMAS 是免訓練框架；每個 agent 將 last-layer hidden state auto-regressively 生成為 latent thought，並以一次性計算的 linear alignment operator 映射回 input space。系統透過 shared working memory 與精確的 cache concatenation，傳遞前一 agent 的完整逐 layer KV cache（涵蓋 input context 與 latent thought），僅由最後一個 agent decoding text。

key_improvements.en: Across nine benchmarks and five Qwen3/Llama3 backbones, LatentMAS improves accuracy over Single by an average of 14.6% and 13.3% in sequential and hierarchical settings, and by 2.8% and 4.6% over the corresponding TextMAS baselines. Relative to sequential and hierarchical TextMAS, it reduces output-token usage by 70.8% and 83.7% and provides 4× and 4.3× faster end-to-end inference, respectively.
key_improvements.zh: 在九項 benchmark 與五種 Qwen3/Llama3 backbone 上，LatentMAS 在 sequential 與 hierarchical 設定中相較 Single 的平均 accuracy 分別提升 14.6% 與 13.3%，相較對應 TextMAS 則分別提升 2.8% 與 4.6%。相較 sequential 與 hierarchical TextMAS，其 output-token 用量分別減少 70.8% 與 83.7%，端到端 inference 分別加速 4× 與 4.3×。

agent_role: Executor / worker, Judge / aggregator, Planner, Coder

reuse_metric.en: The complete layer-wise KV working memory, including the input context and generated latent thoughts, is transferred to the next agent without re-encoding. Under the theorem's same-model, same-input assumption, Theorem 3.3 establishes output equivalence to directly inputting the predecessor's outputs; the sequential evaluation reports a 14.6% average accuracy gain over Single.
reuse_metric.zh: 完整的逐 layer KV working memory（包含 input context 與生成的 latent thought）無須重新編碼即可傳至下一個 agent。在 theorem 的 same-model、same-input 假設下，Theorem 3.3 證明其 output 等價於直接輸入前一 agent 的輸出；sequential 評測則報告相較 Single 的平均 accuracy 提升 14.6%。
